in_items = _items
out_data = []

for item in in_items:
    # HTTP Request se aane wala data nikalna
    weather_data = item["json"]["data"][0]
    
    # API se values dynamically fetch karna (Bina PK hardcode kiye)
    city = weather_data["city_name"]
    country = weather_data["country_code"] 
    temp = weather_data["temp"]
    humidity = weather_data["rh"]
    desc = weather_data["weather"]["description"]
    
    # Final Output JSON banana
    out_data.append({
        "json": {
            "city": city,
            "country": country,
            "temperature": temp,
            "humidity": humidity,
            "weather": desc
        }
    })

return out_data
